placements.why: The envelope's entire content is a technology infrastructure decision — adopting a database for analytics, justifying it with performance metrics, and committing to a migration timeline. No existing strata category covers this organizational domain, so the content calls for minting Architecture as a new top-level strata category.
placements.title: technology infrastructure decisions and their justifications
placements.frame: What technology choices shape the system's foundation, and what evidence drives them?

placements.title: settling on a new analytics database and committing to its execution timeline
placements.frame: How does the organization ratify a new data infrastructure choice and operationalize it through a committed migration schedule?
placements.why: src-1 and src-5 perform the adoption of Zypherion for analytics as a settled decision; src-3 and src-7 operationalize that decision through a committed migration timeline (next quarter / Q3 2026). Together they form a coherent theme — the ratification and execution planning of a new analytics database — that future envelopes will keep feeding as the organization's data infrastructure choices evolve.

placements.title: quantified performance gains marshaled as evidence for a settled technology choice
placements.frame: How does a measured performance comparison function as evidence when the decision it supports is already ratified?
placements.why: src-2 and src-6 carry the 15x columnar-query performance claim — spoken by the CTO and restated in the summary catalog. The conviction gradient marks them as claim, not decision: they justify rather than ratify. This is a distinct thematic subject from the adoption itself — the role of quantified performance evidence in supporting technology decisions — that future envelopes will continue to feed as the organization marshals metrics for its infrastructure choices.
